0022600025.text: The Atlanta Hawks host the Washington Wizards in Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play, the Hawks' 10th game of the 2026-27 season. Atlanta is 5-4, on a two-game winning streak, and sits first in the Southeast and fourth in the East. Washington is 4-4, half a game behind Atlanta in second place in the Southeast and eighth in the East, and enters on a one-game losing streak, while the Hawks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 120-105 win in Washington on November 4 and won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell, Henri Veesaar, Jalen Johnson, Jock Landale, Keshon Gilbert and Mouhamed Gueye, and Washington is without Anthony Davis, Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, all listed as out.
